scope: All 64 originals reviewed in native-size contact sheets and 64/32px sheets, with individual inspection of selected and regenerated originals. Sheets use a checker background; selected originals were also viewed against the image viewer background.
limitations: All 64 source borders now pass after lossless canvas extension. Faint alpha noise inside the preserved delivered canvas remains; no original RGBA pixel was altered.
Occlusion and stylization prevent certification of fine appendage counts.
Small review sprites are scaled directly from original canvas, before future asset-pipeline normalization.
